content:
Apr 22, 2026

Today, significant progress was made in enhancing dispute resolution with a new `SP1Adapter` feature for ZK proof integration, alongside critical bug fixes and dependency updates across the Optimism ecosystem. Key documentation improvements were also delivered, while ongoing discussions address missing Docker image tags and the transition to `op-reth`.

## 🚨 Needs Attention
- **Missing Finalized Docker Image Tags**: Users are reporting missing finalized Docker image tags for `op-reth v2.1.0`, `op-node v1.16.13`, and `kona-node v1.3.0` due to failed builds. Users are advised to use `-rc.1`-suffixed images as a temporary workaround, with a fix expected in the next release. ([ethereum-optimism/design-docs#20228](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/issues/20228), [ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io#20228](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20228), [ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#20228](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20228), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#20228](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20228))
- **Kona-Interop Block Access Review**: Discussion continues regarding how Kona-proofs interop handles internally created blocks, specifically a newly discovered issue where generated receipts for replaced blocks are not stored, potentially causing consolidation failures. A test is being written to confirm this. ([ethereum-optimism/design-docs#19266](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/issues/19266), [ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io#19266](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19266), [ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#19266](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19266), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#19266](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19266))
- **Flaky Test: `TestSequencingWindowExpiry`**: Investigation into this flaky test revealed a race condition in `OpProofsExEx`. A draft fix has been opened, but follow-up actions are needed to address the lack of a regression test and a potential state-machine issue. ([ethereum-optimism/design-docs#20212](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/issues/20212), [ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io#20212](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20212), [ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#20212](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20212), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#20212](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20212))
- **SDM: Move PoC2 Functionality to `develop`**: A pull request has been created and is awaiting review to integrate PoC2 functionality into the `develop` branch. ([ethereum-optimism/design-docs#20216](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/issues/20216), [ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io#20216](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20216), [ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#20216](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20216))
- **`op-reth` vs. `op-geth` Usage**: A user inquired about the mandatory use of `op-reth` and the continued support for `op-geth`, highlighting that `simple-optimism-node` does not yet support `op-reth` as an execution client and requesting an official guide. ([ethereum-optimism/design-docs#20203](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/issues/20203), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#20203](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20203))

## ✅ Completed Work

### Protocol Enhancements & Dispute Resolution
- A new `SP1Adapter` feature was added to `contracts-bedrock` to integrate ZK verifiers for dispute resolution. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#19987](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19987))
- The `chain_id` is now always set for trie hints in Kona's interop provider, fixing a critical bug. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#20164](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20164))
- `OpTx` usage in `alloy-op-evm` was resolved to ensure consistency. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#20231](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20231))

### Stability and Testing Improvements
- Flaky tests related to `TestInteropFaultProofs_VariedBlockTimes_FasterChainB` were closed after being stable for a significant period. ([ethereum-optimism/design-docs#19829](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/issues/19829), [ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io#19829](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19829), [ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#19829](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19829), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#19829](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19829))
- Batcher throttling functionality in `op-reth` and `op-rbuilder` was confirmed and related issues were closed. ([ethereum-optimism/design-docs#18764](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/issues/18764), [ethereum-optimism/design-docs#19023](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/issues/19023), [ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io#18764](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/18764), [ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io#19023](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19023), [ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#18764](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18764), [ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#19023](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19023), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#18764](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18764), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#19023](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19023))
- The `TestUnsafeGapFillAfterUnsafeReorg_RestartL2CL` acceptance test was stabilized. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#20199](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20199))
- Acceptance tests were enhanced to verify deposits bypass the EIP-7825 transaction gas limit cap. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#20222](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20222))
- `op-reth` is now prebuilt for acceptance tests to speed up test startup times. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#20247](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20247))
- Issues related to Kona NUT bundles were closed, including moving them to `op-core/nuts`, parsing, and adding Karst fork scaffolding. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#20237](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20237), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#20238](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20238), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#20240](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20240))

### Documentation and Infrastructure Updates
- A naming convention was updated from "fusaka" to "osaka" in the `protocol/osaka-on-l2.md` file for clarity. ([ethereum-optimism/design-docs#376](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/pull/376))
- The circulating supply data was updated in `tokenomics/circulatingSupply.txt`. ([ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io#1307](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1307))
- Documentation was added to recommend migrating to a specialized op-node topology. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#20192](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20192))
- A comprehensive guide for writing new acceptance tests was introduced. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#20225](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20225))
- `alloy` was updated to version 2.0 across various Rust crates. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#20060](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20060))
- Deputy pause key rotation was restored to `EXECUTED` state and a new rotation was split into a separate task. ([ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#1403](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1403))
- The `OPCMMigrateV700` task template was scaffolded. ([ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#1404](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1404))

## ✨ Contributor Spotlight
- The team working on **`optimism`** made significant contributions today by introducing the `SP1Adapter` for ZK proof integration, stabilizing acceptance tests, and implementing critical bug fixes across Kona, op-devstack, and alloy-op-evm.
- The team managing **`superchain-ops`** ensured accurate tracking of on-chain execution records by restoring a deputy pause key rotation to its correct `EXECUTED` state and scaffolding a new migration task.
